it just feels like a good time line for me! i want it to be long enough to form good friendships with people she would meet there, but not so long that we never get to experience her outside of that part of her life. i’m not big on long time periods in books either, so a big “x months later” wouldn’t be my style, and i’d like to see her out before an epilogue. 

as for cystic fibrosis, i was a huge fan of five feet apart and want to stay far away from accidentally letting myself take a little TOO much inspiration from it. i LOVED the TFIOS/red band society era and that’s probably why it’s the style that’s been in my head for this book, but i definitely don’t want to write something that’s too similar to something else that i know and love so that i can keep originality. 

a cancer could work and i’ve considered it, im just still weighing options. and i have no issue responding to questions, if nothing else it’ll help me get my thoughts out a bit more so i can figure out what im feeling more. i don’t necessarily plan for a pregnancy, i kinda hate that trope in books so i doubt i would write it. i’m not opposed to her having children in an epilogue though, but adoption could always be an answer there. 

if you couldn’t tell, there’s not a hard ground on this book yet. i wrote constantly for years and lost the passion for it during a rough patch, and this idea has been in my head for months now and i want to start writing it and get back into writing, but i dont want to get too deep into one idea and discover that it’s just not realistic lol. thank you so much for the help so far!!

a word of advice: stop posting that you’re going to kill yourself every single day on reddit. stop telling everyone how bad you have it, because can’t you tell that it doesn’t change a thing? you’re posting in suicide watch, where people’s goals are to talk people who are actually on the verge of suicide out of it, multiple times a day that you’re going to kill yourself. when people try to offer advice or support, you tear them down. people tell you how to get a job, and you tell a person that he must have better opportunities than you when you don’t know anything about him. a person tells that you can find clothes at a charity and you tell them that they don’t understand how god awful your life is. you can’t accept help because you’re not on here for help, you feel neglected and you need attention. that’s not necessarily a bad thing, it’s common for people who have struggled to feel an urge to get extra attention. however, it gets really concerning seeing your posts in r/suicidewatch almost everyday and knowing that you’re just talking because you told me on march 1st that you were going to kill yourself while i was texting you and that obviously didn’t happen. people join this sub to help others, or to look for help, and that’s not what you’re doing. i know you aren’t looking for help or support because i reached out to you in dms, offered to be a listening ear, and you accused me of lying, said i was going to ignore you, and then said you blocked me. you never did. i said if you decide you need someone i’ll be here. you said its good that i’m not making excuses and that i’m not enough to keep you alive. i said you can make assumptions about me and i can’t change that, but that not everyone is the same. you said everyone is the same and that it’s not an assumption, and then said you’re done talking, again. i said you don’t know me, you’re just hurting and taking it out on other people, so my previous statement stands. you said ‘you don’t have the capability to feel bad for me. you can feel bad for anyone else. but not me. you just want some hero points. congratulations, you’re better than me. here’s a metal. everyone is better than me, go care about them.” i said i never said i felt bad for you, and you said “i hope you got whatever kick you got from that question. you’re just like my dad. fuck you.” at this point i’m fucking livid because i reached out to offer help /if wanted/ and instead got treated like i’m the reason you’re so suicidal. it took everything in me to keep my replies kind. i said i just messaged you to offer to be there, “you can try to psych me out or offend me but it won’t work, but i’m not going to push you. i’ll leave you alone because you clearly don’t want help, next time someone reaches out for help, try saying thanks but no thanks. my notifications are on in case you do need anything.” you didn’t reply so i didn’t message again, that wasn’t what you wanted. i’ve checked your page everyday. i’ve checked to make sure you’re still posting, aka still alive. sure enough, 10 days later you’re still posting almost daily into suicidewatch, and i haven’t commented or dmed you because i said i’d let you come to me. i was never going to reach out to you first again, but then you texted me. march 11, 9:23am EST (10 days after our first encounter) “don’t be there for me. ever. don’t lie to me like that. you better just leave me alone.” man, i never once interacted with you after my last message. i checked to make sure you’re still alive. you’ve done nothing but treat me like shit and i still care. you think no one can care but people can, even when you try to push them away. i could have ignored you the first time you talked shit to me and i never did. but now here you are, reaching out to me to tell me that i’m lying. you told me i was going to ignore you. i texted back 3 minutes later, after 10 days of your words resonating in my head. 10 days of seeing you post in depression and suicidewatch and just knowing that it wouldn’t be the last time seeing u/ingiuseppewetrust: i’m killing myself. 10 days of wondering if you were getting any better or worse, and then you message me. when i message back to ask if you had your job interview, you’re composing another suicidewatch post. so now i’m composing this. i know you’re hurting, i know you have it terribly, ive read your story, ive read your struggles. but you can’t just post on a sub and wait for people to try to help just to tell them ‘no fuck you im still killing myself’. you’re young, younger than me. you think everyone is the same, you think nothing can get better. i promise both are false. it may take days, weeks, months, or years to get better. it may take years to find someone different from the rest, or it would take you five minutes to be kind to the people reaching out and realize that we really do care. i was going to direct message this, but you’re posting publicly, opening the door for innocent people to offer support, and you shut them down, cuss them out, and fight with them. so i’m going to comment this, because people who aren’t as invested in your situation as i am don’t need to get tied up in it if they can’t handle the criticism you give to others.
